results.title: Mauricio Pochettino arrives at Manchester United with club stuck in relegation zone
results.description: Mauricio Pochettino has arrived in Manchester to take over as the new manager of Manchester United. He previously managed the US national team and has limited time to prepare for upcoming games. United is currently sitting in 18th place in the Premier League after a disappointing start to the season. Pochettino faces high expectations to revive the team’s fortunes amid pressure for immediate results.
